# uptrace_servicenow_channel (Resource)

Manages an Uptrace ServiceNow notification channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "example" {
  name = "My Organization"
}

resource "uptrace_project" "example" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.example.id
  name   = "api"
}

resource "uptrace_servicenow_channel" "example" {
  project_id = uptrace_project.example.id
  name       = "alerts-servicenow"
  priorities = ["high"]

  url      = "https://instance.service-now.com"
  username = "alertuser"
  password = "alertsecret"

  category = "software"
  impact   = "2"
  urgency  = "1"
  severity = "2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable channel name.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) ServiceNow password.
- `priorities` (List of String) Alert priorities to match. Valid values: info, low, medium, high.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID this channel belongs to. Changing this forces recreation.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) ServiceNow instance URL.
- `username` (String) ServiceNow username.

### Optional

- `assigned_to` (String) Assigned to user.
- `caller_id` (String) Caller ID.
- `category` (String) Incident category.
- `condition` (String) Alert condition expression.
- `due_date` (String) Due date.
- `group` (String) Assignment group.
- `impact` (String) Incident impact (1, 2, or 3).
- `match_all` (Boolean) Match all monitors. If false, monitor_ids must be provided.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs to match when match_all is false.
- `notify` (String) Notify setting (1 or 2).
- `opened_by` (String) Opened by user.
- `severity` (String) Incident severity (1-5).
- `subcategory` (String) Incident subcategory.
- `urgency` (String) Incident urgency (1, 2, or 3).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Channel ID.
- `status` (String) Channel status (delivering, paused, disabled, draft).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_servicenow_channel.example 1:42
```
